changes.before: Idealized homogeneous solution: acid + alcohol ⇌ ester + water, stoichiometry 1:1:1:1. At equilibrium at T: c(acid)=c(alcohol)=0.20 mol/L and c(ester)=c(water)=0.40 mol/L; activities are approximated by c/c° with c°=1 mol/L. Write the mass action expression, calculate K and interpret equilibrium position. Calculate the quotient immediately after doubling acid concentration. Distinguish it from K. Separate transfer: Fresh homogeneous 1:1:1:1 system with cP=cQ=0.10 and cR=cS=0.50 mol/L: determine K for P+Q⇌R+S and its reverse.
changes.after: Idealized homogeneous solution: acid + alcohol ⇌ ester + water, stoichiometry 1:1:1:1. At equilibrium at T: c(acid)=c(alcohol)=0.20 mol/L and c(ester)=c(water)=0.40 mol/L; activities are approximated by c/c° with c°=1 mol/L. Write the mass action expression, calculate K and interpret equilibrium position. Calculate the quotient immediately after doubling acid concentration. Distinguish it from K. Separate transfer: Fresh homogeneous 1:1:1:1 system at a fixed temperature with measured equilibrium concentrations cP=cQ=0.10 and cR=cS=0.50 mol/L: determine K for P+Q⇌R+S and its reverse.
